title: Hardship Desk Calculation: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Good-Faith Amount
content:
**Hardship desk calculation — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

The good-faith amount is the tier's good-faith percentage (as the product's extension terms give it for the contract's tier) of the contract's monthly payment, rounded to the cent. The percentage is a single figure for the contract, applied once to the monthly payment; the good-faith amount is never below zero.

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Monthly payment | the contract record |
| Good-faith percentage | the product's extension terms for the contract's tier |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Monthly payment 517.30 dollars on a tier whose good-faith percentage is taken, for illustration, as 40 percent: 40 percent of 517.30 is 206.92 dollars, so the good-faith amount is 206.92 dollars.

On a tier whose good-faith percentage is 0, the good-faith amount is 0.00 dollars.

## Rounding

The product of the percentage and the monthly payment is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end: with a hypothetical 33 percent of 412.47 dollars, the exact figure 136.1151 rounds to 136.12 dollars.
